idea.title: Reel or carousel for a listing? Use both
idea.angle: A Reel helps new people find the listing; a photo carousel lets interested buyers look closely at each room. Post the 15-second video as a Reel and the best photos as a carousel, with the same keyword on both.
idea.hook: REEL OR CAROUSEL? USE BOTH, LIKE THIS.

caption:
Reel or carousel? You don't have to choose.

A Reel helps new people find the listing.
A photo carousel lets interested buyers look closely at each room.
Post the 15-second video as a Reel and the best photos as a carousel.
Put the same keyword on both, like TOUR1, so you know which listing each message is about.
Same photos. Two formats. More buyers see it.

Which do you post more today?

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
